title: Smooth sunset sailing at Barcelona
text: Great experience. Smooth sailing, nice and clean boat, decent drinks and some tapas to accompany.
author: fernandonpa

title: 2 hour boat ride in Barcelona harbor
text:
We went out on a 2 hour boat ride around the Barcelona harbor on a sunny afternoon. Although the boat had sails, they remained furled and we were under motor the entire time.

The captain identified all of the building landmarks and some of the more noteworthy  yachts that we passed. Even more interesting, he talked about his life experiences (He was born in Cuba, and while he has lived in Barcelona for many years, his extended family has lived in many part of the Spanish speaking world.

All in all, a very pleasant adventure.
author: douglashF8985TS

title: We absolutely LOVED our...
text: We absolutely LOVED our experience!!!!! Maria was the absolute best! She kept our drinks full, made sure we got the most out of our tour, and even went out of her way to make sure we captured great photos of our experience! Highly recommend!
author: Katie_W

title: Jose was awesome a...
text: Jose was awesome a wonderful captain, kind and encouraged us to jump into the ocean.  He made our trip special and was proactively asking to take pictures of us and making sure we just really had a great time.
author: Anita_T

title: Great Voyage!
text: Christobal was a great captain. Very knowledgeable and accommodating. Would Absolutely recommend this experience! 10/10 ✅
author: Antonino_C

title: A Day of Sailing
text: Very enjoyable outing. Cristobal, was an excellent captain and very entertaining. I would definitely recommend this for anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: Deborah_E

title: Fun Sailing
text: A fun time sailing the Mediterranean!  Boat was very nice and a small group made it enjoyable.  Wine, beer, and snacks were provided.  Captain (forgot his name) was fun and informative with questions we had about Barcelona.  Definitely a memorable experience and would recommend.
author: Snapurbia

title: Amazin Experience!!
text: The experience was great! Our capitan was Manuel, he was very kind and professional. We enjoyed the views of Barcelona and had great tapas and cava.
author: Natalia_A

title: Extraordinary!
text:
Extraordinary!
I have never had such a wonderful experience. Thanks to the captain's warm hospitality and the receptionist who is proficient in five languages, I strongly recommend that you must experience this trip when you go to Barcelona. The four of us agreed that it was the best project for the trip.
author: Ziye_C

title: A special time
text: Violeta did a wonderful job and made us all feel save (especially my mum who was a bit worried before!), I could have stayed on board for longer and will surely repeat!! Booking the private tour was so worth it!
author: MARIA_M
